newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TML sees good H2 in core operations.
newsitem.headline: TML sees good H2 in core operations.

text.p: South African publishing group Times Media Ltd (TML) said on Monday that the second half outlook for its core publishing operations looked good, though its markets are set to get more competitive.

Earlier the firm posted a half year pre-exceptionals earnings per share of 158 cents, up from 139 cents. The period saw a 47 percent increase in contributions to operating profit from its core buinesses.
TML said its Business Day, Financial Mail and Eastern Province Herald publications all performd well.

The firm said the losses at its magazine operations should reduce over the next two years. It also warned that its DMX Africa operations would see unspecified, but large development losses for the current and next financial years.
"TML nevertheless remains confident that this business will be successful and make significant contributions to the results in years to come," the firm said.
TML, which is in talks on a possible alliance with Britain's Pearson Plc, said it continued to seek out new expansion opportunities, either through organic growth or through buys.
